Usage: mcpjam tools call [options]
  --tool-name <tool>            Tool name
  --name <tool>                 Alias for --tool-name
  --tool-args <json>            Tool parameter object as JSON, @path, or - for
  --params <json>               Alias for --tool-args
  --tool-args-stdin             Read tool parameter JSON from stdin
  --args <arg...>               Preferred stdio command arguments. Pass multiple
